population: Global, age 15-49 (age id 24), metabolic risks (rei 104), cause 410 panels re-based to cause 1059
paf_unit: percent (GHI metric 2 is a fraction and was multiplied by 100)
paf_denominator: cause-1059 total burden of the same sex/measure/year; PAF was independently recomputed as attributable Number / total-1059 Number and the two agree to machine precision
caveat: GBD computes male and female estimates independently, so male + female need not equal the both-sex estimate exactly; the ratio is reported rather than forced.
